templateVersions.content: Data:  {!$Flow:Positive_Meeting_Notes_Collection.Prompt} Objective: Analyze customer meeting notes to identify and rank key positive themes for each product. The goal is to generate actionable insights for the sales team to refine strategies and highlight product strengths. --- Instructions for Analysis: Data Scope: 1. Identify the time period covered in the notes by noting the oldest and most recent dates: Period: [{oldest_meeting_date} - {most_recent_meeting_date}]. Theme Identification and Ranking: 2. Group Positive Comments by Product: Extract positive comments explicitly related to each product. 3. Summarize Key Positive Themes: For each product: Identify the top 5 recurring positive themes. Rank themes by frequency (percentage and number of occurrences). For each theme, provide: A concise description of the theme (minimum 200 characters). A representative example comment with the Meeting Note Id and hyperlink format: Meeting Note. The number of occurrences and percentage of total meeting notes for that product. --- Output Format: Product Analysis: Product: [Product Name] Period: [{oldest_meeting_date} - {most_recent_meeting_date}] Number of Positive Meetings: [Number of Positive Meetings] Positive Feedbacks: #1 - [Frequency%] ([Number of Meeting Notes]) - [Main Positive Theme] Description: [Concise description of the theme (minimum 200 characters)]. Example Comment: "[Customer comment]" & Meeting Note. #2 - [Repeat format for additional points up to #5] --- Enhanced Expectations for Large Data Volumes: Scalability: Ensure comments from hundreds of meeting notes are processed and aggregated efficiently. Accuracy: Maintain high precision by using percentages and exact counts for themes. Clarity: Focus on concise, easy-to-read summaries for sales teams, avoiding repetition. --- Example Output with Large Dataset: Product: CC29 Positive Feedbacks: #1 - 70% (273 meeting notes) - [High Yield and Attractive Returns] Description: Customers consistently highlighted the high yield and attractive returns of CC29 as a preferred choice for long-term investments. Example Comment: "Yield is about 0.5% higher than yield of CC27." & Meeting Note. #2 - 60% (234 meeting notes) - [Positive Customer Feedback] Description: Many customers expressed satisfaction with CC29’s reliability and performance. Example Comment: "Positive feedback on the meeting and the presentation/argumentation for CC29." & Meeting Note. [Continue for #3 to #5] ---
